questions.question: A psalm writer said God's hands made him. What did he ask God to give him?

answers.text: Strength to defeat all his enemies
Riches to take care of his family

questions.question: In a psalm praising God's law, what does the writer say about the LORD's word?

answers.text: It is everlasting and fixed in the heavens
It is hidden and hard for anyone to find
It is only for the priests in the temple

questions.question: A psalm writer said enemies nearly wiped him from the earth, but he had not forsaken God's precepts. True or false?
A psalm writer who praised God's law said that God's commandment has a limit. True or false?
